name: sessions_send
label: Sessions Send
description: Send a message into another session by session key or label. Used for cross-session and agent-to-agent communication.

sessionKey.description: Target session key. Provide either sessionKey or label, not both.

label.description: Target session label. Provide either sessionKey or label, not both.

agentId.description: Agent ID to scope label lookup to a specific agent

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout in seconds for the send operation (0 = fire-and-forget)
